{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS268 |prevtitle=The Escape |nextcode=PS270 |nexttitle=Now You See Me... |series=FireRed & LeafGreen |colorscheme=FRLG}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Return to Pallet Town |subtitle=The Invisible Attacker |title_ja=姿なき攻撃者 |title_ro=Shapeless Attacker |image=PS269.png |scheme=FireRed & LeafGreen |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 269 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|22}} |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 269 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|23}} |location=[[Pallet Town]] }} '''Return to Pallet Town''' is the 269th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the second chapter of the {{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}. It is subtitled '''The Invisible Attacker''' (Japanese: '''姿なき攻撃者''' ''Shapeless Attacker'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} In [[Pallet Town]], a group of children try and capture a wild {{p|Nidorino}}. One boy throws a {{i|Poké Ball}} at the Nidorino, but it easily knocks the ball away. When the boy groans in frustration, another person approaches him and tells the boy that he should use the {{p|Gengar}} he has to battle it. The boy complies with the person and sends out his Gengar to battle the Nidorino and succeeds in facing it. The person who helped the boy is revealed to be {{adv|Red}}, who had returned to Pallet Town with {{adv|Blue}}. As Red and Blue walk to {{adv|Professor Oak}}'s lab, they comment about how Pallet Town hasn't changed since they were last there. Upon entering the lab, Red and Blue notice that it is empty. They notice three devices with letters, that are addressed to Red, Blue, and {{adv|Green}}, placed next to them. Upon checking the letters, they notice that the text on them mentions [[Vermilion City]]. Before they can open the letters, Red and Blue hear a commotion outside. They check what's happening, only to find an invisible opponent is attacking their Pokémon. They try and find out what's attacking them, but the enemy is too fast for the [[Pokédex]] to scan. Red and Blue have their Pokémon attack the opponent, but it dodges the moves and flies off to escape. Red decides that if Professor Oak is not there to meet them, then there must be a reason why he is not at the lab. Red prepares to go and find Professor Oak, but Blue decides to check out the [[Fame Checker]] that was included with the letters. Upon activating the Fame Checker, a recording of Professor Oak plays. Much to Red and Blue's shock, the recording reveals that Professor Oak intends to take the Pokédex away from them. ==Major events== * {{adv|Red}} and {{adv|Blue}} return to [[Pallet Town]]. * Red and Blue are attacked by an {{adv|Deoxys|invisible Pokémon}}. * Red and Blue learn that {{adv|Professor Oak}} intends to take the [[Pokédex]] from them. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} * {{adv|Blue}} * Children ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Venusaur}} ([[Saur]]; {{adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Charizard}} ({{OP|Blue|Charizard}}) * {{p|Gengar}} (boy's) * {{p|Deoxys}} ({{adv|Deoxys|Adventures}}; {{DL|Deoxys (Adventures)|Organism No. 1}}/{{tt|Entity One|Chuang Yi}}; invisible) * {{p|Nidorino}} ==Trivia== * The battle between the wild {{p|Nidorino}} and the boy's {{p|Gengar}} mimics the opening cutscenes from {{game|Red and Blue|s}} and {{game|FireRed and LeafGreen|s}} as well as the opening of the first chapter of Pokémon Adventures, ''[[PS001|A Glimpse of the Glow]]''. ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|FRLG}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|FRLG}} |zh_yue={{tt|透明的攻击者|Transparent attacker}} |zh_cmn={{tt|看不见的敌人|Invisible enemy}} (Taiwan)
